presentationTable.name: Base Warehouse - Inventory Movement KPIs
presentationTable.description: Base warehouse inventory movement ledger at Store + SKU + Week grain. Use this folder for operational stock-flow analysis: opening stock, replenishment, transfers, fulfilled sales, estimated demand, estimated lost sales, and ending stock.

presentationColumns.name: Movement Week Start Date
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Movement Week Start Date
presentationColumns.description: Week represented by the inventory movement ledger row. Use it with Store and SKU to review stock flow over time.

presentationColumns.name: Date Key
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Date Key
presentationColumns.description: Hidden date key used to join inventory movement rows to the Date dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Store ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Store ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden store key used to join inventory movement rows to the Store dimension.

presentationColumns.name: SKU ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.SKU ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden SKU key used to join inventory movement rows to the Product dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Collection ID
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Collection ID
presentationColumns.description: Hidden collection key used to join inventory movement rows to the Collection dimension.

presentationColumns.name: Opening On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Opening On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: Physical stock on hand at the start of the store-SKU-week. Use it as the starting balance for inventory-flow analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Replenishment Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Replenishment Units
presentationColumns.description: Units received through normal replenishment during the store-SKU-week. These units increase available supply before fulfilled sales are deducted.

presentationColumns.name: Transfer In Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Transfer In Units
presentationColumns.description: Units moved into the store during the store-SKU-week, typically from another store or source. Use it to analyze transfer actions separately from standard replenishment.

presentationColumns.name: Transfer Out Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Transfer Out Units
presentationColumns.description: Units moved out of the store during the store-SKU-week. These units reduce the stock available to fulfill local demand.

presentationColumns.name: Estimated Demand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Estimated Demand Units
presentationColumns.description: Estimated unconstrained customer demand for the store-SKU-week, equal to fulfilled units sold plus estimated lost sales units. This is modeled demand, not a directly observed POS count.

presentationColumns.name: Fulfilled Units Sold
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Fulfilled Units Sold
presentationColumns.description: Units actually sold and fulfilled from available supply during the store-SKU-week. This reconciles to core sales quantity at the same grain.

presentationColumns.name: Estimated Lost Sales Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Estimated Lost Sales Units
presentationColumns.description: Estimated demand that could not be fulfilled because stock was exhausted. Positive values indicate missed demand, not observed sales.

presentationColumns.name: Ending On Hand Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Ending On Hand Units
presentationColumns.description: Physical stock on hand at the end of the store-SKU-week after replenishment, transfers, and fulfilled sales.

presentationColumns.name: Ending Available Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Ending Available Units
presentationColumns.description: Sellable units available at the end of the store-SKU-week after reservations or unavailable stock are excluded.

presentationColumns.name: Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Scenario Tag
presentationColumns.description: Internal data-generation scenario marker; hidden from business-facing analysis.

presentationColumns.name: Fulfilled Demand Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Fulfilled Demand Percent
presentationColumns.description: Percentage of estimated demand that was fulfilled. Use it to quantify how much demand was served when supply was constrained.

presentationColumns.name: Estimated Lost Sales Rate Percent
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Estimated Lost Sales Rate Percent
presentationColumns.description: Estimated lost sales as a percentage of estimated demand. Use it to rank stockout severity independently from fulfilled sales volume.

presentationColumns.name: Supply Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Supply Units
presentationColumns.description: Opening stock plus inbound supply less transfer-out units. This is the supply available before fulfilled sales are deducted.

presentationColumns.name: Net Inventory Change Units
presentationColumns.sourceLogicalColumn: logicalColumn:Fashion Retail DW.Inventory Movement KPIs.Net Inventory Change Units
presentationColumns.description: Change in physical on-hand units from the beginning to the end of the week. Negative values show depletion; positive values show inventory build-up.
